title: ITU-T Recommendations Q.23 and Q.24: DTMF Sending and Reception
where: Official ITU-T recommendation records and freely readable English PDFs: https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-Q.23-198811-I and https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-Q.24-198811-I. ITU copyright is retained; reading access does not grant republication or adaptation rights.
toc: Q.23 §§6–7 and Figure 1/Q.23 — two four-frequency groups, keypad allocation, transmit tolerance, and distortion limit
Q.24 §§2.2–2.5 — receiver pair validity, frequency tolerance, received power/twist considerations, and timing
Q.24 Annex A — administration-specific example parameter values rather than one universal receiver threshold table

shards.range: Q.23 §§6–7 and Fig. 1/Q.23; Q.24 §§2.2–2.5 and Annex A
shards.note: Only the clauses needed for the DTMF receiver application are retained as a compact citation cache; no recommendation PDF is redistributed.
shards.pdf_pages: Q.23 printed pp. 1–2; Q.24 printed pp. 1 onward through Annex A

notes: The official ITU-T records list both November 1988 recommendations as in force and freely available. Q.23 defines the sending code; Q.24 describes receiver parameters and explicitly notes national/application variation. Course materials may cite and paraphrase these clauses but must not republish ITU text, tables, or figures without permission.
